snippet.title: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The latest title in the Dragon Quest Monsters series, "DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World,"
has been announced for release on:
・Nintendo Switch™ 2
・Nintendo Switch™
・PlayStation®5
・Xbox Series X|S
・Steam®
・Microsoft Store on Windows

Please stay tuned for more information in future updates.

▼ Official Website for DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
https://dragonquest.com/dqmtww（TBC）

▼ Official Dragon Quest X Account
https://x.com/DragonQuest
